title: Library Drift Check
summary: Flags registered library roots that have source on disk but nothing in the index
intro: Read this when a library index may have gone stale or was never built. The library-drift verb (or Library Drift Check in the IDE) flags every registered library root that has source on disk but nothing in the index, and exits 2 when it finds drift.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Library Drift Check...
steps: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Library Drift Check...
The registered library roots that have source on disk but nothing in the index are reported

surfaces.usage:
drag-lint library-drift [--platform

] [--config ] [--json] - registry library roots that have source on disk but none in the index (exit 2 if drift; roots the section exclude prunes are listed as excluded, not counted)
help:
